_README: LifeLine demo policy catalog -- FICTIONAL HACKATHON PRODUCTS.
Every entry is a fictional demo product created for the codeLinc 11 hackathon.
None of these are actual Lincoln Financial products, quotes, premiums, guarantees,
underwriting rules, eligibility requirements, rates, or recommendations.
This file is a structured transcription of the Markdown sources in
knowledge/demo-policies/. It contains no premiums, coverage amounts, eligibility
criteria, underwriting requirements, rates, or guarantees, because the source
files do not contain any. Fields the source does not provide are null.
This catalog is deliberately separate from knowledge/lincoln-documents/ and must
never be mixed into the Lincoln RAG corpus or the Bedrock Knowledge Base.

_required_labels.is_demo_product: Always true. Marks the entry as fictional.
_required_labels.actual_lincoln_product: Always false. This catalog contains no real Lincoln products.
_required_labels.ui_label: Every policy card must display this in the UI.
_required_labels.ui_label_text: Hackathon Demo - Not an actual Lincoln Financial product or quote

policies.ui_label: Hackathon Demo - Not an actual Lincoln Financial product or quote
policies.demo_disclaimer: HACKATHON DEMO - FICTIONAL PRODUCT. This is not an actual Lincoln Financial policy, quote, premium, or recommendation.
policies.primary_tradeoff: Coverage is temporary and does not build cash value
policies.tradeoffs: A defined term can align with temporary obligations and may have a lower relative cost than permanent coverage. The tradeoff is that coverage ends after the defined period and the policy does not build cash value.
policies.demo_purpose: Illustrates straightforward protection for a defined 20-year period. It is intended for scenarios involving time-bound financial responsibilities such as income replacement, a mortgage, debts, or supporting dependents while they are younger.
illustrated_situations: A family has dependents who rely on the insured person's income.
A mortgage or other obligation is expected to decline over time.
The user wants to explore protection during a defined period.
guardrails: LifeLine may present this as an example to compare with other demo structures.
It must not say that this product is best for the user or that the user should purchase it.

policies.ui_label: Hackathon Demo - Not an actual Lincoln Financial product or quote
policies.demo_disclaimer: HACKATHON DEMO - FICTIONAL PRODUCT. This is not an actual Lincoln Financial policy, quote, premium, or recommendation.
policies.primary_tradeoff: Longer temporary protection, but coverage still ends and no cash value accumulates
policies.tradeoffs: Compared with a shorter term example, a longer term keeps the illustrative protection period in place longer. It remains temporary coverage and does not provide cash-value growth.
policies.demo_purpose: Illustrates straightforward protection for a longer defined period of 30 years. It can be used in the demo when a user's time-bound obligations extend further into the future.
illustrated_situations: Younger dependents may require support for many years.
A mortgage has a long remaining term.
The user wants to compare different temporary coverage periods.
The user has long-duration but still time-bound obligations.
guardrails: LifeLine should explain why the duration may or may not line up with the user's stated obligations without recommending that the user purchase this product.

policies.ui_label: Hackathon Demo - Not an actual Lincoln Financial product or quote
policies.demo_disclaimer: HACKATHON DEMO - FICTIONAL PRODUCT. This is not an actual Lincoln Financial policy, quote, premium, guarantee, or recommendation.
policies.death_benefit_characteristic: May vary based on policy structure
policies.cash_value_characteristic: Potential growth linked to an index
policies.market_framing: Index-linked; not direct investment in the index
policies.primary_tradeoff: More complexity and cash-value potential versus straightforward term protection
policies.tradeoffs: This demo structure adds potential cash-value features and greater flexibility compared with term insurance, while also introducing more complexity. Cash-value growth should never be described as guaranteed.
policies.demo_purpose: Illustrates longer-term life-insurance protection with potential cash-value growth tied to a market index.
illustrated_situations: The user wants to understand protection intended to remain in place longer.
The user asks about potential cash value in addition to a death benefit.
The user wants to compare term insurance with a permanent insurance structure.
The user wants to understand index-linked growth concepts.
guardrails: LifeLine must not describe index-linked cash-value growth as guaranteed.
LifeLine must not imply direct investment in an index.
LifeLine must not present this demo product as an actual Lincoln Financial offering.

policies.ui_label: Hackathon Demo - Not an actual Lincoln Financial product or quote
policies.demo_disclaimer: HACKATHON DEMO - FICTIONAL PRODUCT. This is not an actual Lincoln Financial policy, quote, premium, guarantee, investment recommendation, or insurance recommendation.
policies.death_benefit_characteristic: May vary based on policy structure
policies.cash_value_characteristic: Potential growth based on investment options
policies.primary_tradeoff: Greater growth potential can also involve greater variability, expenses, and risk
policies.tradeoffs: The demo structure can illustrate greater growth potential alongside greater exposure to market movement. Cash value can fluctuate and growth is not guaranteed.
policies.demo_purpose: Illustrates longer-term life-insurance protection with cash value that may fluctuate based on investment options.
illustrated_situations: The user wants to understand permanent coverage with market-linked investment exposure.
The user asks how VUL differs from IUL.
The user wants to understand the relationship between potential growth and market risk.
guardrails: LifeLine must not provide investment advice.
LifeLine must not select investment options.
LifeLine must not state that VUL is appropriate for a particular customer.
